_about: Land limits for council DCP rules whose own words limit them to part of the land: a zone list (sets v2_applicable_zones), heritage items/areas only (sets v2_marker='heritage'), or a named place/precinct/street/site with no outline in our data (precinct layer with no key = shown to no house, as an unmapped area). Read by scripts/gate_rules_land.py and re-applied after every publish by gate_rules.apply_gate_rules. A row matches by council + chapter + text fingerprint (never_serve.text_key). Only rows with no value yet are changed. Source: Haiku 5.5 'applies when' labels (ce-applies-when-2026-11-07 corpus), checked against the served-answer audit 2026-11-20 (37 wrong-land flags). Rows whose own heading or first 300 characters say excluding/except/other than are never hidden as place-specific.
